_evidence: 0x00556d1b: `mov al,[edi+0x2b]; cmp al,0xff; jne` with edi a ring record 0..29 (caller 0x556b44 steps edi by 0x160 per record): 0xff takes the remembered byte [0x871c78] (`mov al,[0x871c78]`), any other value is stored there; the byte is written back to +0x2b. Only an equality compare reads it, so every byte is valid; 0xff is weighted (random bytes hit it 1/256) so both branches occur, the rest are low, mid, sign-bit and 0xfe neighbours. Byte +0x2b of records 0..31 (0x8943cb + k*0x160) is not covered by the ring/flag layouts it composes with (their +0x2c dwords start one byte later).
